description: Get the findings Wardzo detected on your monitored sites since this connection last checked (background re-scans, re-checks and new sites), newest last, and mark them as seen for this connection. A finding that stays open across scans is reported once, not every scan. The first call on a new connection returns every open finding. Each item has an issue_id for explain_issue, a status (open, or resolved if it was already fixed by the next scan) and evidence (secrets masked). Use mark_seen=false to peek without marking, or since (ISO timestamp) to list findings first seen after a time (does not move the marker). Filtering by site is also a peek.

limit.description: Maximum findings to return (default 50). If more are waiting, call again.

mark_seen.description: Mark the returned findings as seen for this connection (default true)

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-27T08:00:00Z. Returns findings first seen after it, ignoring and not moving the last-seen marker.

site.description: Only this site (id, domain or URL). Peek only: does not mark anything as seen.

name: get_new_findings
title: Get new findings since last check
